category_title: Failing students who engage in collaborative coaching and strategic planning
scenario_title: Initial observation and strategic planning in badminton
minimal_context: The student is acting as a coach for a teammate during a badminton match and is tasked with recording point locations on an observation worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please watch your teammate's match and record the point locations on your observation worksheet. Remember, the theme is hitting to the front and back zones.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is stupid. My teammate just keeps sending the shuttlecock right to the central zone of the other court anyway. It's not even hard for the opponent to hit back.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep watching the game and write down what happens on your sheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even know where it landed that time. It's moving too fast, so I'm just going to guess and put a mark somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to be as accurate as you can with your data collection.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I've already made a ton of mistakes on this worksheet. I missed the last few shots so I just scribbled random marks all over the paper. I don't see why I have to fill this out.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please watch your teammate's match and record the point locations on your observation worksheet. Remember, the theme is hitting to the front and back zones.

STUDENT: I don't even know where it landed that time. It's moving too fast, so I'm just going to guess and put a mark somewhere.

TUTOR: Try to be as accurate as you can with your data collection.

STUDENT: I've already made a ton of mistakes on this worksheet. I missed the last few shots so I just scribbled random marks all over the paper. I don't see why I have to fill this out.

task.content: Recording point locations on a worksheet while acting as a coach for a teammate during a match, and formulating a strategic project before a set
task.learning_goal: Hitting to the front and back zones

context.environment: General classroom setting for first-year secondary school students in Marseilles, France, during a six-lesson badminton unit
context.materials: Observation worksheet, badminton court physically marked into three zones (front, central and back), shuttlecock
context.social_setting: Teammate-based dyad where one teammate is functioning as a player and the other is the coach
context.time_context: During the pre-test session and initial lessons

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initial use of the observation worksheet by students in the collaborative 'coach' class during the pre-test session
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: High number of observation errors and a high standard deviation, which reflected a difference in the quality of the data collection between students

behavior_patterns.condition: During the initial lessons of the unit when playing badminton matches
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Frequently sent the shuttlecock to the central zone of the opposing court, which was not difficult for the opponent
